name: colorful
description: Set the text color of replies, prompts, notices and other transcript rows

reply.title: Reply color
reply.description: Color of Claude's replies: a name (red, cyan), a hex (#ff8800), a theme key (claude, success) or default

prompt.title: Prompt color
prompt.description: Color of your own prompts in the transcript, or default

info.title: Info color
info.description: Color of the info notices under the logo, or default

command.title: Command output color
command.description: Color of slash command output, or default

duration.title: Turn duration color
duration.description: Color of the line that closes a turn, or default

hint.title: Hint color
hint.description: Color of the hint line under the prompt, or default
